policies.title: Moldovan ordinary passports: visa-free travel to North Macedonia
policies.summary: Moldova MFA's current official outbound list says holders of Moldovan biometric or non-biometric passports travel visa-free and expressly includes Macedonia.
conditions: Moldovan ordinary biometric or non-biometric passport; the MFA list labels the destination “Macedonia”, mapped here to North Macedonia (MK).

The live list does not state a visitor-stay cap, a purpose restriction, or special-document treatment; work, residence, diplomatic, official, service and final-admission rules are outside this policy.
The source is passport-issuer guidance rather than North Macedonia's destination-side schedule and should be rechecked before travel.
